column4: summary
Operator types a natural-language query and the system returns ranked nodes with graph-grounded 'why this matched' annotations. Powered by Bedrock Titan embeddings + Claude Haiku reranker.
Operator carries a conversation across multiple turns; each assistant turn includes citations to graph nodes; conversation history is preserved per snapshot in localStorage.
Chat answers anchor every claim to a node summary or edge in a one-hop subgraph snapshot. The LLM cannot return invented nodeIds (schema-aware ranker drops them).
Operator saves a chat turn to a per-graph knowledge base; future queries auto-include matching KB entries as context.
Common-language queries are expanded with domain-specific synonyms before embedding. Lexicons are per-Tier-2-domain JSON files; defaults ship empty.
Per-graph embedding cache keyed by SHA-256 of sorted node ids; re-embeds only when snapshot or model changes; persisted alongside the graph data.

Operator types '/' in any chat or search input and a combo-box dropdown lists every available command with description and category. Type-ahead filters by name; argument coaching shows graph-grounded examples.
Every node is classified into one or more pipeline segments (biz
column7: meta). Seam nodes (features biz↔dom; functions dom↔imp) inhabit two segments. Pure function; importable from client + server.

column4: /biz /dom /imp commands show the named layer's segment members plus the outbound-edge boundary into the layer strictly deeper in the pipeline. Direction-aware so /dom does not re-expand back to biz via feature IMPLEMENTS edges.

Renderers support a setFilter(keepIds) method that HIDES non-matching nodes (not dims). Distinct from focus() which expands via 1-hop neighborhood. Segment commands use setFilter; constellation commands use focus.
